'''Ungarr Daris''' was a powerful [[Human/Legends|Human]] politician from [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].

==Biography==
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Daris was kidnapped by [[Tyber Zann]] for the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. He cooperated after his security forces failed and on the understanding that he and his family would not be harmed.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' {{1st}}
